name: Keibord
subtitle: Private, on-device keyboard
description: Keibord is a private keyboard that works fully on your iPhone: German (Austria) and Albanian QWERTZ, English UK/US and Italian, multilingual autocorrect, learning, smart touch zones, emoji search, tinted keys and local AutoFill. Nothing is sent anywhere.

apps.name: Keibord
apps.subtitle: Private, on-device keyboard
apps.localizedDescription:
A private keyboard that works fully on your iPhone.

• German (Austria) and Albanian on QWERTZ, English UK/US and Italian – all at once, with multilingual autocorrect, accent restoration and predictions
• Learns your words and where you tap; smart touch zones enlarge the letters you are likely to type next
• Export and import all typing data (optionally encrypted) to move devices
• iOS look with themes, custom colours and permanently tinted keys
• Emoji 17 with search in four languages and skin tones
• Local AutoFill for your details and encrypted cards (the CVV is never stored)

After installing: Settings → General → Keyboard → Keyboards → Add New Keyboard → Keibord, then allow Full Access so your settings and learning reach the keyboard. Your signer must keep the app group for the app and the keyboard.

versions.localizedDescription:
Keibord 1.0.11: the keyboard no longer opens blank.

- Sometimes the keyboard opened empty (only 🌐 and the microphone below it) until it was closed or switched. While opening and closing, the keyboard waited for its files; when iOS had paused the Keibord app (or another copy of the keyboard) in the middle of saving, that wait never ended and no keys were drawn. Opening and closing no longer wait for any file: settings are read directly, and what the keyboard learned is saved in the background.
